caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bank called "SPEAKING DOG" made of metal and painted in various colors, primarily red, brown, yellow, green, and black. The bank features a seated figure of a girl wearing a red dress, a yellow-brimmed bonnet, and black boots, with a blue ribbon tied at her collar. Next to her, a brown dog with a yellow collar sits on its haunches, raising its right front paw towards the girl’s raised left hand. Both figures are positioned on a rectangular, decorated platform with the text "SPEAKING DOG" embossed and painted in yellow on a red background along the front base. The surface of the platform and the figures show areas of paint wear, revealing the underlying metal. The background is a solid light cream color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Toy Bank: Speaking Dog and Figure
